notes: the report has two isnads for one saying: «حدثنا ... حدثنا ...» repeats the head, and «نحوه» marks the same saying, so both are routes (groups), not variants
«ذكرت ذلك لعيسى بن موسى فحدثني أنه، سمع غيلان بن أنس» makes Isa, then Ghaylan, the links (rule 5)
«قال اسم الله الأعظم…» is Qasim's own statement: he is the last link of the first route
